## What it is

Goulotte / pont de test pour fils Helutherm : un segment de canal droit, un plot d'aimant 8×3 mm au nord, puis le même segment droit après. `puit_sud=1` ajoute le plot miroir au sud, même X et Z. U de 7 × 7 mm internes. Imprimée ouverte vers le haut ; on la retourne pour coller la face 0,6 mm sur le châssis métal.

## Contexte projet

- Même atelier que le boîtier : A1 Mini, PLA HT recuit, aimants 8×3 mm, fond de puit 0,6 mm.
- Puits du canal légèrement plus larges que ceux du boîtier (8,2 vs 8,15) : le disque doit glisser jusqu'au fond d'un puit profond. 8,4 était trop lâche (l'aimant ressortait en retournant la pièce) ; 8,2 testé et confirmé via `canal_test`.
- Cible : goulottes 230 V / Grove de la roadmap `../README.md`.

## Design notes

Printed as a U on the bed (open +Z). One trapezoid pad, centered on the north (+Y) wall, fuses into the wall: a solid margin around the well, then angled returns back to the channel on both sides. `puit_sud=1` mirrors that pad onto the south (−Y) wall, same X and Z. Each well is a vertical cylinder from the bed up to a 0.6 mm bridged face. Flip onto the chassis: open rim and magnet face meet the metal.

Well Ø from `aimant_diametre` + `aimant_puit_press_fit` (8.2 mm). Walls 1.68 mm. `aimant_canal_press_fit` exists in measurements but is unused here.

`segment_longueur` (default 20 mm) is the straight channel length on each side of the pad, not to the well center: the well sits at the middle of the channel, and each side is `segment_longueur + puit_r + marge_puit + retour_biais` long.

`ouverture_ouest` and `ouverture_est` (default 0, off) each cut a notch through the south wall, flush with the west (low X) or east (high X) end of the channel. Cables exit sideways there. With `puit_sud`, an opening that reaches the south pad is refused. `cable_tie_ouest` / `cable_tie_est` (default 0) cut a pair of collier slots through both U walls, just west/east of the pad; they are refused if they run off the end, overlap an opening, or stick out of the wall in Z.

`min_wall = 0.6` is intentional for the magnet faces.

## Don't

- Do not run a full-length magnet rail. The pad stays local around the well.
- Do not put the magnet well in the U floor.
- Do not reintroduce `puit_diametre`: well size comes from `measurements.toml`. 8.2 is confirmed good via `canal_test`; go no tighter without a fresh coupon.
- Do not thicken the 0.6 mm magnet face for the default min_wall.
- Do not close the ends. Wires enter and leave along X.
- Do not print this the use way up.
- Do not drop `epaisseur_paroi` under about 1.2 mm on a 100 mm run.
- Do not move the cable-exit openings onto the north wall to dodge `puit_sud`; refuse the overlap instead.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6

[variants.canal_double]
note = "Puits d'aimant sur les deux faces Y, même X et Z."

[variants.canal_double.params]
puit_sud = 1
```

## Changelog

- 2026-09-11 — `puit_sud` (0/1) mirrors the magnet pad onto the south face. Openings that reach that pad, and cable ties that run off the end, overlap an opening, or leave the wall in Z, are refused.
- 2026-09-10 — Well size from `measured()` (`aimant_*`); `puit_diametre` slider removed. Walls 1.6 → 1.68. U interne 10 → 7 mm. `cable_tie_ouest` / `cable_tie_est` added (default 0).
- Split `ouverture` into `ouverture_ouest`/`ouverture_est`, both default 0 (no notch) so David can choose which end gets the cable-exit slot.
- Reduced to a single magnet well: `aimants`/`longueur`/`marge_extremite` replaced by `segment_longueur` (straight run on each side of the one pad). David no longer needs the multi-magnet 170 mm version.
- Tightened `puit_diametre` to 8.2 mm (from 8.4): confirmed via `canal_test` after 8.4 let the magnet fall out on flipping.
- Added `ouverture`: cable-exit notch flush with the near end of the channel, on the wall opposite the wells.
- Extended to 170 mm; end pads pinned 10 mm from each channel end via `marge_extremite`.
- Local magnet pads with angled returns; well Ø 8.4 mm for deep insertion.
- First test coupon: 10×10×100 mm U.
